notes.title: Minor Feature Patch
notes.content:
[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved Teslas Leash functionality - Now targets enemies where the user aims instead of what enemy they click on.
[*] Added new crosshair visual to HUD when in combat.
[*] Added enemy hit indication to HUD.
[*] Added a blinking indication to HUD when player is at low health.
[*] Rebalance rocket explosion damage radius and visual effect scale.
[*] Fixed some enemy sounds not being spatial.
[*] Fixed some audio sources not being assigned to the corresponding audio mixer.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Patch
notes.content:
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed "The cycle continues..." achievement being granted on first death.
[*] Added guaranteed repair kit drop when deafeating mini bosses.
[/list]

notes.title: Roguebot 2.0 Release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44054964/a8b0cc5bbf4c1ff6ecc7c0c0baf2d16d6bb9a9ae.jpg[/img]

[b]The huge 2.0 Update is finally here! It overhauls almost all game mechanics and brings tons of new features.[/b]

[h1]Some of the new stuff[/h1]

[h2]Levels[/h2]
[list]
[*] Procdurally generated Levels
[*] 3 different and unique sections (like biomes in other games)
[*] Environmental hazards
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44054964/458ffa129992f01141c85d9c89047b61b8d5f3e5.gif[/img]

[h2]Enemies[/h2]
[list]
[*] One new enemy
[*] Two new mini bosses
[*] Reworked end boss fight
[*] Enemy tier system, showing visually how strong they are
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44054964/08c2920b7a7a381d7bb4c089259502df38c5a9c9.jpg[/img]


[h2]Upgrading your Roguebot[/h2]
[list]
[*] Maintenance area to upgrade roguebot with 3 additional slots
[*] Three randomly rolled items to choose from each time maintenance is visited
[*] Leg slot for upgrading movement
[*] Dash slot for different dash modifications
[*] Melee slot with 2 types of melee items
[*] Use machine scraps, dropped by enemies to buy stuff
[*] Merge parts to upgrade their rarity (if you have the skill unlocked)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44054964/8216bdb8d61103cf636d55501b3500457cd413cc.gif[/img]

[h2]Skill Tree[/h2]
[list]
[*] Unlock skills with config shards
[*] Unlock special abilities
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44054964/23b913baa18fbaf9d533fa5712ef8738d22b6c0e.png[/img]

[h2]Combat[/h2]
[list]
[*] Overhauled and rebalanced all prior weapons and attachments
[*] Meleeee!!!
[*] Stun enemies through melee attacks
[*] Downgrade enemy tier with stuns (if you have the correct skill)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44054964/622b650bf7bb259e2a1db4abd45a439c75f495e7.gif[/img]

[h2]Story[/h2]
[list]
[*] New dedicated story rooms
[*] Transmissions!
[*] Revamped ending ;)
[*] New game plus!
[*] More lore in overall
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44054964/e3f8b9136971bdc75f6d40ea510220856e239f80.gif[/img]

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content: Fixed a bug where the player has only 100 health when freshly starting the game.

notes.title: Balance Patch
notes.content:
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Laser Pro and Ultimate damage increased.
[*] Laser Pro and Ultimate ammo count increased.
[*] Rocket Pro and Ultimate ammo count increased.
[*] Player health increased.
[*] Enemy difficulty now scales up to floor 100.
[*] Minibosses health increase.
[*] Melee Miniboss damage increase.
[*] Projectiles getting stuck in elevator fixed.
[*] Performance optimization.
[*] And many more minor adjustments.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Feature Patch
notes.content:
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] The Miniboss on Floor 10 is now nolonger randomly chosen.
[*] The Bullet Light ammo drop can now only be dropped if the player has unlocked OS Version 3.
[/list]
